description: Returns a dentalunlock.com link for starting a dental malpractice insurance quote request, with any known answers prefilled, and a summary of the next steps and typical timeline. Relevant when a dentist asks how to get actual malpractice quotes or wants to shop or switch their coverage. All inputs are optional. Does not submit anything; the dentist completes the request on dentalunlock.com.

ada_member.description: Is the dentist an American Dental Association (ADA) member?

agd_member.description: Is the dentist an Academy of General Dentistry (AGD) member? Membership can affect the estimate.

claims_last_5_years.description: Any malpractice claim, lawsuit, or dental-board action in the last 5 years? Default false.

graduation_year.description: Year the dentist graduated dental school (or will graduate this year). Provide this OR years_practicing.

policy_type.description: occurrence (default — no tail bill when leaving) or claims_made.

practice_type.description: Where they practice: private_practice (default), dso (corporate/DSO), group_practice, or other.

risk_management_ce.description: Has the dentist completed risk-management CE in the last 12 months?

sedation_level.description: Highest level of sedation the dentist provides. Default "None".

specialty.description: The dentist's specialty. Use "General Dentist" for general practice.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

weekly_hours.description: Average clinical hours per week: under_20, 20_32, or 33_plus (default 33_plus = full-time).

years_practicing.description: Years since dental school graduation. Used only if graduation_year is not given.

name: start_malpractice_quote
title: Link to request dental malpractice quotes
